wake_word.basic_desc: Wake word toggle and keyword settings

wake_word.tip: When enabled, say "{{keyword}}" to wake the character. The character will respond "Here" and enter voice assistant mode. Wake word uses the local Vosk engine for offline recognition — no internet required, no audio uploaded. Listening is automatically paused while the voice assistant is active to avoid echo false triggers.
